paragraphs.text: Alchemy: Phyrexia is a MTG Arena -exclusive card set in the Alchemy -series that was released on February 28, 2023.

Alchemy: Phyrexia is a digital only release adjacent to the release of Phyrexia: All Will Be One . There are 30 new designed-for-digital cards included in the set (10 uncommons, 15 rares, 5 mythic rares) . All of the cards are set on New Phyrexia . The set introduces the Preferred Printing selection for cards with multiple versions.

The digital-only mechanics Boon , Conjure , Intensity , Not the starting player , Perpetually , Seek and Spellbook are reused. From the main set, Corrupted , For Mirrodin! , Proliferate and Toxic are used, alongside Oil counters .
( ) Ghalma the Shaper conjures Tempered Steel .

paragraphs.text: The Into the Future event associated with Alchemy: Phyrexia was held on Magic: The Gathering Arena from February 28 to March 2, 2023. It featured four phantom preconstructed decks intended to highlight how new cards could be used in the Alchemy format.
